title: Can I BEAT Giveaway Chess? (Antichess)
summary: First (highly requested) Giveaway/Antichess video vs online humans: capturing is compulsory and you win by losing all your pieces. Goal: win three games. He loses game 1 by trying to develop pieces normally, learns to stay passive and force recaptures, wins game 2 (losing the king like any piece), promotes to a king at one point, takes several losses, and finally wins the third game when his last pieces get STALEMATED (a stalemated side wins).
rules: If you can capture, you must (choice among captures allowed).
King has no royal status: no check, can be captured; castling not allowed.
Pawns can promote to a king (7:00 'promotion to a King').
A player with no legal moves wins (29:30 'we get stalemated yes we win our third game').
win_condition: Lose all pieces or be stalemated. Series goal: 3 wins.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board; 'WINS' overlay with king icon at the end.

visual_fx: 'WINS' king card overlay at game end.
